data.gender_notes: Itzz is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Itzz is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Iti', which means 'Sun' and 'zz' represents the zest and glow of the Sun. This name reflects the warm, energetic, and radiant nature of the Sun. The name Itzz carries the meaning “Sun's Glow” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Itzz usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's glow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
